# OutlineDev

> OutlineDev is a free coding mentorship and bootcamp platform that helps developers master JavaScript, React, Angular, Node.js, Full Stack development, and System Design through 1-on-1 expert guidance and AI-powered learning.

OutlineDev provides structured learning paths, expert mentorship sessions, mock interviews, resume reviews, and global certifications. The platform is 100% free and serves developers across India and worldwide.

## Key Offerings

- [JavaScript Bootcamp](https://outlinedev.com/path/javascript): Comprehensive JavaScript curriculum from fundamentals to advanced patterns including async/await, closures, and ES2024+.
- [React Masterclass](https://outlinedev.com/path/react): Complete React training covering hooks, performance optimisation, server components, and Next.js 15 App Router.
- [Angular Complete Guide](https://outlinedev.com/path/angular): Full Angular curriculum including signals, SSR with Nitro, standalone components, and micro-frontends.
- [Node.js Backend](https://outlinedev.com/path/nodejs): Node.js, Express, REST APIs, streaming, worker threads, and native SQLite.
- [System Design](https://outlinedev.com/system-design): Scalable architecture, database design, caching, load balancing and FAANG-level interview preparation.
- [AI Assessment](https://outlinedev.com/ai-quiz): AI-powered skill assessment quiz to benchmark your current coding level.
- [1:1 Mentorship](https://outlinedev.com/mentorship): Book live 1-on-1 sessions with senior engineers for code reviews, debugging, and career guidance.
- [Become a Mentor](https://outlinedev.com/become-mentor): Apply to become a mentor and share your expertise.
- [Tech Blog & Tutorials](https://outlinedev.com/blogs): In-depth tutorials on React, Angular, Node.js, AI tools, Playwright, and modern web development.
